test_sim_interface: test the SimInterface by patching gRPC and running arm and gripper control callbacks
run_sim_client: run the SimInterface client with a time horizon of 100 steps at 250 Hz
register_arm_control: register arm control with state and action callbacks on the SimInterface client
register_gripper_control: register gripper control with state and action callbacks on the SimInterface client
create_sim_wrapper: create a SimWrapper class with arm and gripper state and action callback methods
